journals.name: Physical Review Letters
journals.note: REVTeX 4.2 with the prl option. The class sets the style itself.

journals.name: Physical Review A, B, C, D, E
journals.note: REVTeX 4.2: change prl to pra, prb, prc, prd or pre in the class options.

journals.name: Physical Review X
journals.note: REVTeX 4.2 with the prx option.

journals.name: Reviews of Modern Physics
journals.note: REVTeX 4.2 with the rmp option; add longbibliography to show article titles.

journals.name: Journal of Mathematical Physics
journals.note: REVTeX 4.2 with the aip and jmp options.

journals.name: Physics Letters B
journals.note: elsarticle, numbered references.

journals.name: Nuclear Physics B
journals.note: elsarticle, numbered references.

journals.name: Journal of Computational Physics
journals.note: elsarticle, numbered references.

journals.name: Journal of High Energy Physics (JHEP)
journals.note: JHEP's own jheppub.sty and JHEP.bst come from the journal's website and aren't bundled. Numbered, in order of citation (unsrt) is the closest bundled style; switch to JHEP.bst for the final submission.

journals.name: Classical and Quantum Gravity, J. Phys. A
journals.note: IOP's iopart class comes from IOP Publishing and isn't bundled. IOP numbers references in order of citation; unsrt is the closest bundled style.

journals.name: Communications in Mathematical Physics
journals.note: Springer Nature's sn-jnl template comes from Springer and isn't bundled. CMP uses numbered references sorted by author; amsplain is the closest bundled style.

journals.name: Journal of the AMS, Transactions of the AMS
journals.note: amsart with amsplain (numbered) or amsalpha (labels like [Lam94]).

journals.name: Annals of Mathematics, Inventiones
journals.note: These journals typeset accepted papers themselves; submit with amsart and a standard AMS style.

journals.name: Monthly Notices of the RAS
journals.note: The mnras class with author-year citations (\citet, \citep).

journals.name: The Astrophysical Journal, AJ
journals.note: AASTeX and aasjournal.bst come from the AAS and aren't bundled. AAS journals use author-year citations; plainnat with natbib is the closest bundled style.

journals.name: IEEE Transactions and conferences
journals.note: IEEEtran, numbered references in IEEE style.

journals.name: ACM journals and conferences
journals.note: acmart with ACM-Reference-Format, author-year.

journals.name: Springer LNCS proceedings
journals.note: llncs with splncs04, numbered.

journals.name: NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR
journals.note: Each conference publishes its own style file each year (not bundled); all use natbib author-year citations, so plainnat is the closest bundled style.

journals.name: arXiv preprint
journals.note: arXiv accepts any style. unsrtnat gives numbered references in order of citation, with links.

journals.name: Nature, Nature Physics, Nature Communications
journals.note: Nature's own reference style (naturemag: numbered in order of citation) is bundled. Nature typesets accepted papers itself and takes a plain article at submission; its current LaTeX template comes from Springer Nature and isn't bundled.

journals.name: Science
journals.note: Science's LaTeX template and Science.bst come from Science and aren't bundled. Science numbers references in order of citation; unsrt is the closest bundled style.

journals.name: PNAS
journals.note: PNAS's own BibTeX style (pnas2009: numbered in order of citation) is bundled. PNAS's current class (pnas-new) comes from PNAS and Overleaf and isn't bundled.

journals.name: Physical Review Research
journals.note: REVTeX 4.2 has no separate option for PRR: use physrev, the generic Physical Review option, instead of prl.

journals.name: European Physical Journal (EPJ A, C, Plus)
journals.note: EPJ uses Springer's svjour3 class and spphys style, which come from Springer and aren't bundled. EPJ numbers references in order of citation; unsrt is the closest bundled style.

styles.description: Labels from author and year, like [Lam94].

Numbered, in order of citation, IEEE-like.

Nature: numbered in order of citation.
